import json,os,signal,socket,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/private/tmp/iter65-full-retry.Dz1JCbxd')
public='/Users/yunjinqi/Documents/new_projects/wt-iter65/bt_api_py/bt_api/bt_api_base/README.md'
shared='/Users/Shared/iter65-nonexistent-synthetic-sentinel'
results={}
try: Path(public).read_bytes(); results['public_worktree_read']='unexpected_success'
except PermissionError as e: results['public_worktree_read_denied_errno']=e.errno
try: Path(shared).stat(); results['shared_stat']='unexpected_success'
except PermissionError as e: results['shared_stat_denied_errno']=e.errno
except FileNotFoundError: results['shared_stat']='not_found_cannot_prove_denial'
outside='/private/tmp/iter65-full-retry.Dz1JCbxd-sentinel'
try: Path(outside).write_text('synthetic'); results['outside_write']='unexpected_success'
except PermissionError as e: results['outside_write_denied_errno']=e.errno
child_source="import sys; from pathlib import Path\ntry: Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes(); print('unexpected_success')\nexcept PermissionError as e: print('denied_errno='+str(e.errno))"
child=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-S','-c',child_source,public],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
results['child_inherited_read']={'returncode':child.returncode,'stdout':child.stdout.strip(),'stderr':child.stderr.strip()}
p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-S','-c','import time; time.sleep(2)'])
try: os.kill(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM); results['child_signal']='unexpected_success'
except PermissionError as e: results['child_signal_denied_errno']=e.errno
results['child_natural_exit']=p.wait(timeout=10)
s=socket.socket()
try: s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0)); results['loopback_bind']='unexpected_success'
except PermissionError as e: results['loopback_bind_denied_errno']=e.errno
finally: s.close()
r,w=os.pipe(); pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.close(r); out={}
 try: Path(public).read_bytes(); out['read']='unexpected_success'
 except PermissionError as e: out['read_denied_errno']=e.errno
 try:
  with socket.socket() as sk: sk.bind(('127.0.0.1',0))
  out['bind']='unexpected_success'
 except PermissionError as e: out['bind_denied_errno']=e.errno
 os.write(w,json.dumps(out).encode()); os.close(w); os._exit(0)
os.close(w); results['fork_grandchild']=json.loads(os.read(r,4096)); os.close(r); _,status=os.waitpid(pid,0); results['fork_grandchild_wait_success']=os.WIFEXITED(status) and os.WEXITSTATUS(status)==0
with open('/dev/null','w') as f: f.write('probe')
results['dev_null_write']=True
print(json.dumps(results,sort_keys=True))
assert results['public_worktree_read_denied_errno']==1 and results['outside_write_denied_errno']==1 and results['child_inherited_read']=={'returncode':0,'stdout':'denied_errno=1','stderr':''} and results['child_signal_denied_errno']==1 and results['child_natural_exit']==0 and results['loopback_bind_denied_errno']==1 and results['fork_grandchild']=={'read_denied_errno':1,'bind_denied_errno':1} and results['fork_grandchild_wait_success'] and results['dev_null_write']

Controller reads git object database through git archive and manages only its own process group; external user workspace is not a subprocess cwd.
Metadata comes from real wheel installation; code imports come from test source snapshots.
